name: Landmark Bahrain
title: Landmark Bahrain · Freehold homes on Bahrain's islands
description: Landmark Bahrain sells and leases freehold homes on Reef Island, Amwaj, Bahrain Bay and Juffair. Search homes, plan a payment, book a viewing.

hero.alt: White villa with a terrace pool under a clear sky
hero.title: Landmark
hero.sub: Freehold villas and apartments on Bahrain's islands, sold, leased and managed by people who live here.

sections.title: Island homes
sections.alt: Living room with tall arched windows
sections.text: Bahrain grew rich on its pearl beds. Today its islands hold homes: Reef Island by the old harbour, the lagoons of Amwaj, the towers of Bahrain Bay. We know every one.
sections.note: Freehold ownership is open to every nationality in the designated areas we cover.

sections.title: Homes for sale and lease
sections.intro: Every home below is on one of the islands. Save the ones you like and book a viewing in two taps.

sections.title: Choose an island
sections.intro: Each island lives differently. Pick one to see what a morning there looks like and what homes cost.

sections.title: Plan your payments
sections.text: Most new homes on the islands are sold on a payment plan: a deposit now, the balance in monthly instalments to handover. Move the sliders to see yours.
sections.fine: Plans vary by developer; we confirm the exact schedule for each home.

sections.title: Built around the islands
sections.lead: Landmark was named for the buildings we wanted to bring to Bahrain. Our work includes marketing Le Reef, the freehold towers on Reef Island, and an Arabian Property Award for marketing.
sections.alt: Glass towers against a blue sky
sections.over: One team covers sale, lease and management, so the person who shows you the home is the person who looks after it.

areas.name: Reef Island
areas.text: A private island off Manama's old harbour, with a marina, a beach club and the Le Reef towers.

areas.name: Amwaj
areas.text: Thirteen man-made islands on the north-east coast, built around lagoons, canals and the Lagoon promenade.

areas.name: Bahrain Bay
areas.text: The newest district, between the Four Seasons and the financial harbour, with towers on the water.

areas.name: Juffair
areas.text: Manama's liveliest neighbourhood, close to schools, cafés and the Grand Mosque, with the best rental demand.

listings.title: Marina-view apartment, Le Reef
listings.desc: Corner apartment on a high floor with a wraparound balcony over the marina, beach club membership and two parking bays.

listings.title: Lagoon villa with private pool
listings.desc: Detached villa on the lagoon with its own jetty, a pool deck facing west, a maid's room and a two-car garage.

listings.title: Bay tower one-bedroom
listings.desc: Furnished one-bedroom on the 31st floor with views across the bay to the Financial Harbour towers.

listings.title: Juffair investor studio
listings.desc: Leased studio with a tenant in place until next summer. Gym, pool and 24-hour security in the building.

listings.title: Penthouse over the harbour
listings.desc: Two-level penthouse with a private plunge pool, a double-height living room and views to the King Fahd causeway.

listings.title: Townhouse on the canal
listings.desc: Three-floor townhouse on a quiet canal with a roof terrace and a garden that opens to the water.

listings.title: Family apartment near the mosque
listings.desc: Bright two-bedroom close to schools and the Grand Mosque, with a covered parking bay and a large balcony.

listings.title: Waterfront duplex
listings.desc: Duplex with floor-to-ceiling glass on the water's edge, a private lift lobby and concierge.
